description: Agent Negotiation: submit one negotiation record: the parties with their ids and roles, each offer with its id, the party that made it, when, the offer it answers and its terms, and the final agreement with its time, the offer it accepts, the agreed terms and the parties that confirmed it. The signed report reads the trail from the first offer to the agreement and says whether the agreement matches a recorded offer term for term, and names no offers, every undated offer, an agreement that matches no recorded offer and every agreed term found in no offer, then offers from no listed party, answers to offers the record lacks or dated before them, an undated agreement or one dated before its offer and every party that did not confirm it, with the fix for each. An approval record is wever_approval-record-check, a buyer’s record of paid calls is wever_purchase-record-check and delegation records are wever_delegation-record-check. Verdict trail_broken, trail_gaps, trail_unverified or trail_complete. POST /api/negotiation-record-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-negotiation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-negotiation/.
